cookieConsent.title: Essential tracking
cookieConsent.description: Menuyukti uses Google Analytics 4 to count page views on public pages and the signed-in workspace so we can see how the product is used. The print shop is not tracked.

preferences.essentialDescription: Includes sign-in, security, core platform functionality, and site usage measurement (page views on public pages and the workspace). Always on. The print shop is not included.
